title: The voice connector now exposes the full Servex tool set behind the secret address

owner_note.text: After tonight's restart the connector lists every Servex tool, including file and command access, as the voice mastermind built from your "grant full permissions" ask. The only lock is the secret address. Your call to keep it; my recommendation is to put the Cloudflare Access login in front of the tunnel this week, or to narrow the list back to ask_mastermind plus the read tools until then. Say which and I do it.
